Meet the icons

01 / The personalities
The enigmatic leading man

Gifu.

Poised. Athletic. Remarkably handsome. With a gaze that says more than words ever could, Gifu has mastered the art of making absolutely every moment a portrait opportunity.

Signature look: effortless woodland chic ↗
The original icon

Nola.

Radiant, unmistakable and endlessly loved. Nola is the sort of presence that lights up a room without even trying. Some dogs have personality. Nola has an entire era.

Signature look: timeless, joyful elegance ↗
